# Player Dealt Damage

Source: [4820](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4820); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4820-n1"></a>

- Dealt Damage includes self-damage and checks rule conditions when the event occurs.

<a id="wiki-4820-n2"></a>

- Event Player and Attacker are the damage dealer; Victim is receiver (same as attacker for self-damage). Context includes Event Damage, critical hit, Event Ability and incoming Event Direction.

Source limitations:

- Page omits concurrency/retrigger handling and does not establish event behavior for barriers/owned objects.
